name: testimonials-carousel
description: Auto-scrolling testimonial carousel with avatar, quote, name, and role for social proof

ai.whenToUse: Use when you want to display customer testimonials one at a time in a scrolling carousel. Perfect for landing pages, product pages, and SaaS sites that need social proof prominently displayed.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use when you have fewer than 3 testimonials. Avoid when all testimonials need to be visible at once — use testimonials-wall instead.
